definitions.name: pos_rewrite_coupon_history_orders_insert
definitions.statement: BEGIN IF @pos_rewrite_coupon_history_owner IS NOT NULL AND (OCTET_LENGTH(@pos_rewrite_coupon_history_owner)<>36 OR NOT REGEXP_LIKE(@pos_rewrite_coupon_history_owner,'^[a-f0-9]{8}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{12}$','c')) THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='Coupon history owner is invalid'; END IF; INSERT INTO pos_rewrite_coupon_history_heads(kind,scope_id,revision,last_owner_nonce,owner_start_revision) SELECT kind,CAST(scope_id AS CHAR),1,@pos_rewrite_coupon_history_owner, CASE WHEN @pos_rewrite_coupon_history_owner IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 0 END FROM (SELECT 'coupon' AS kind, NEW.coupon_used AS scope_id UNION SELECT 'customer' AS kind, NEW.user_id AS scope_id) AS affected WHERE scope_id IS NOT NULL AND (kind='controls' OR scope_id>0) ORDER BY kind,scope_id ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE owner_start_revision=CASE WHEN @pos_rewrite_coupon_history_owner IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN last_owner_nonce <=> @pos_rewrite_coupon_history_owner THEN owner_start_revision ELSE revision END, last_owner_nonce=@pos_rewrite_coupon_history_owner, revision=revision+1; END
